title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
summary: How tiny, compounding improvements and well-designed systems build lasting habits. Covers identity-based change and the four laws of behaviour change.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
summary: Why distraction-free concentration is rare and valuable, and how to structure your life to do more of it.

title: Slow Productivity
author: Cal Newport
summary: A sustainable alternative to busyness: do fewer things, work at a natural pace, and obsess over quality.

title: Feel-Good Productivity
author: Ali Abdaal
summary: How positive emotion fuels output, using play, power and people as energisers and tackling the emotional roots of procrastination.

title: Getting Things Done
author: David Allen
summary: The five-step GTD system for capturing, clarifying and organising every commitment so your mind can stay calm and focused.

title: Stillness Is the Key
author: Ryan Holiday
summary: Ancient wisdom on cultivating calm across mind, spirit and body in a noisy world.

title: The Power of Now
author: Eckhart Tolle
summary: Why living in the present moment eases suffering, and practical ways to observe your thoughts and accept what is.

title: Why We Sleep
author: Matthew Walker
summary: The science of sleep stages and circadian rhythms, the costs of sleep loss, and habits for better rest.
